sources.title: Choosing Safe Art & Craft Supplies for Children
sources.publisher: American Academy of Pediatrics; Sophie J. Balk and Ruth A. Etzel
sources.location: Updated 16 July 2024; material-selection and closing supervision/storage guidance
sources.access: Full article text and update/source notice read on 2 October 2026. Underlying testing reports not independently appraised.
sources.summary: Advises checking labelled child art supplies, avoiding unsuitable or unidentified materials, supervising use and storing supplies appropriately.
sources.limit: Labels do not guarantee safety. US-oriented guidance is not Indian product certification, an exact crayon specification or approval of this MIRA activity. Current local availability, dimensions, breakage, access needs and exposure risks need qualified review.
sources.rights: Original brief paraphrase and link only; no copied images, extended quotations or article reproduction. Independent rights review remains required.
